name: Check Sky Light
description: Check Sky Light is a civilian UAP observation and aerospace diagnostics PWA modeled after the automotive Check Engine light, empowering everyday citizen scientists to investigate aerial anomalies using smartphone sensors and the multi-model AI collaboration that makes its analysis possible. Built around four modules—TARGET (optical AR HUD with live IMU gyro telemetry), RADAR (live ADS-B transponders, NOAA balloons, NORAD satellites, JPL ephemeris, and GPS-linked live weather), ANALYZE (Dual-Lens physics contrasting Classical Aerospace against Metric Manipulation, multi-AI consensus, CGI detection, DoW PURSUE knowledge alignment, and strict safety guardrails), and REPORT (PDF and MUFON field dossiers)—Check Sky Light filters conventional traffic, weather, and hoaxes before evaluating UAP residuals.
